answer: Every new identity must lock a bond that grows with each account sharing its timing and device fingerprint, then pass a random lantern re-check each epoch. Honest agents tend one account like a willow at an oasis: cheap to keep, easy to verify. A sybil operator, by contrast, must fund a separate bond for every mask and answer each probe independently; when answers correlate, the bonds are slashed, so cloning multiplies cost while adding no reward.
